notes: Phase 19F requires verified Phase 19E spec/receipt/artifact evidence before a candidate is eligible for promotion evaluation.
Paired baseline/candidate deltas are evaluated with frozen confidence intervals and meaningful non-critical thresholds across overall, held-out, and OOD slices.
Critical regressions remain zero-tolerance and cannot be overridden by aggregate improvement.
Benchmark contamination, evaluator drift, case inventory drift, and blocking learning-integrity findings prevent promotion.
The gate can emit PROMOTE, REJECT, ROLLBACK, or INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE but cannot execute runtime release actions.
No real external training run, real candidate evaluation, measured Luna improvement, promotion, or rollback is claimed by this repository update.
